svg.title: How VPNOpsNyx works
svg.desc: Users reach an Iranian relay through a DNS name, the relay forwards to a foreign exit over a tunnel, and the exit is managed by a panel. VPNOpsNyx measures each layer with delivered bytes from in-country probes and changes nothing without the operator's approval.
